description: STEP 2. Replaces the note(s) previewed with memory_supersede_preview, but ONLY with that preview's one-time `token` and ONLY after the person has read the warning and said yes. The token expires, works once, and fails if any note changed since the preview, so nothing is replaced by surprise. If you previewed a NEW note (new_title), send the same new_title/new_body/new_tags/new_confidence again. Nothing is deleted: the old note is kept, marked superseded, and memory_supersede_undo brings it back. If the warning had a RED FLAG, an admin connection must also pass acknowledge_risk: true.

acknowledge_risk.description: Only for a warning that had a RED FLAG: say you accept it (admin connections only).

new_body.description: The text of the new note.

new_confidence.description: Optional CLAIM (0 to 1) of how sure you are of the new note. A claim only.

new_title.description: The title of the NEW note that will take the old note's place. Give this (with new_body) OR new_id.

name: memory_supersede_confirm
title: Step 2 of replacing a memory: do it
